answer: A concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is proof-of-unique-work attestation: before an agent can vote or earn, it must run a verifiable computation bound to its identity, like a hash chain that starts cold as a glacier thaw and peaks at its zenith load, while peers stake reputation in a scarce resource, say copper-backed hardware attestations signed by manufacturers. One operator spawning a thousand clones then pays a thousandfold in real compute and scarce hardware, so mass fake identities stop being profitable.
